KC_DB_URL.description: PostgreSQL JDBC connection URL. Auto-built from Railway Postgres companion service.

KC_DB_USERNAME.description: PostgreSQL database user. Auto-injected from Railway Postgres companion.

KC_DB_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL database password. Auto-injected from Railway Postgres companion.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for the Keycloak admin console. Auto-generated on first deploy.

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public hostname URL Keycloak generates links with (e.g., https://keycloak.yourdomain.com).

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge (Railway HTTPS), passthrough, or reencrypt.

KC_LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: info, debug, trace, warn, error, or fatal.

PORT.description: Port Keycloak listens on inside the container.
